CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 10 / 10

Efficiency and welfare

Insurance and excessive use保險與過量使用

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Apply marginal analysis to insurance: compare the consumer's out-of-pocket price with society's marginal cost, and explain the possible effect on the quantity of care.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

病人自付低於社會邊際成本時，可能使用價值高於自付但低於成本的服務。保費若不隨使用次數改變，不增加每項服務的邊際價格。

When a patient's out-of-pocket price is below the true marginal social cost, the patient may choose units valued above their own payment but below society's cost. Fixed premiums do not add to the marginal price of a procedure.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A procedure worth $60 costs society $100; the insured patient pays $20. It is privately attractive but reduces total surplus by $40. 私人想做，社會淨損四十。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Value=$70, social cost=$100, copayment=$20. Social surplus from the procedure? 總剩餘變化？
